programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: God didn’t just rescue Israel from Egypt to bring them to a land—He brought them to Himself. That was always His goal: relationship before destination. “I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself” (Ex. 19:4, NIV). His first priority wasn’t geography but intimacy. Just as in Eden, when God searched for Adam and Eve after their fall, He still seeks us when we drift. He calls out, “Where are you?” (Gen. 3:9), yearning to restore what was lost. Jesus echoes that call: “Come to Me... and I will give you rest” (Matt. 11:28). Our response determines everything.

Helpful parents can make a huge difference, but God makes an even bigger one, for His thoughts are on our eternal benefit, not just in this life. Over two programs, Graham Weir shares his testimony as these very things became his reality. You will be amazed at what he was able to achieve––despite his disability. He even set some records, or "firsts".

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for a compelling episode titled Victory in Jesus, featuring powerful reenactments of divine interventions that changed lives forever. Hear the story of Andy, whose midnight cable hack led him to a life-altering encounter with God. Lourdes, in San Juan, Puerto Rico, found 3ABN when she was at her lowest point, contemplating suicide, and heard a message that changed everything. And Frank, on the brink of ending his life, turned to 3ABN for comfort and found hope through a message from John Carter. Tune in for this heart-touching episode that showcases God's incredible power to save, heal, and transform even in the darkest moments.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an inspiring episode titled Saved to Share, featuring Dan’s incredible transformation. Raised in the Christian Church, Dan struggled with a distorted view of God, leading him into a life of drugs and alcohol. After a stroke and open-heart surgery, he began changing his lifestyle, seeking a closer relationship with God. Through a local radio station broadcasting 3ABN programming, Dan discovered the Seventh-day Adventist Church and began studying the Bible. As his faith deepened, he experienced a life-changing rebirth, which led to a new diet, new perspective, and a passion for sharing Jesus with others. Tune in to hear how 3ABN played a pivotal role in saving Dan’ s life and transforming him into a powerful witness for Christ.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an emotional episode titled Through the Valley, featuring Pauletta’s heartbreaking yet hopeful journey. As a rebellious teenager, Pauletta faced unimaginable loss, including the tragic murder of her son and later, the suicide of her younger son. Struggling with grief, she prayed for change and embarked on a transformative journey, driving to a new life. Along the way, a bird’s extraordinary behavior led her to feel God's presence and guidance. Arriving in Fort Worth, Pauletta discovered 3ABN and began watching its life-changing programs. Through the support of a local church and Bible studies, Pauletta's faith was restored, and she found peace and healing. Tune in to hear how God led her through the darkest valley and into His loving embrace.

programme.title: Miracles In Motion
programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an inspiring episode titled Willing to Follow, featuring Arlena’s journey of faith. Raised in a congregational church, Arlena’s life took a detour into the 1960s rock-and-roll and drug culture. After a divorce and move, she began seeking spiritual fulfillment, asking God for guidance. Her journey led her to watch 3ABN and Better Life TV, where she was drawn in by the music and the powerful message of the Fourth Commandment. After meeting an older couple at the doctor's office, Arlena began attending Sabbath services and was eventually baptized. Tune in to hear how Arlena’s search for truth led her to a loving church family and a deeper relationship with God.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to one of the few active volcanoes in the contiguous United States to find out why it’s called, “God’s gift to creationists.” Through cataclysmic events back in the 1980s, similar geologic features worldwide can now be explained by the Flood using Mount St. Helens as a scale model. Noah explores each of these features at the mountain, including a huge lava cave and lava cast forests. The features found here can help us understand catastrophic processes that were thought by secular scientists to take millions of years taking only hours or days.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Descubre los principios bíblicos que revelan si el mensaje, el carácter, las predicciones y la influencia de un profeta están de acuerdo con la Palabra de Dios. Aprende por qué el discernimiento es esencial y cómo los creyentes pueden reconocer el verdadero ministerio profético y evitar el engaño con mayor confianza.\.

programme.title: Salvación en Señales y Símbolos
programme.desc: El programa “Salvación en Señales y Símbolos” tiene como propósito educar al interesado en entender el Apocalipsis. Romper cualquier duda o barreras que mantenga a lector alejado, intimidado, o tenga cualquier predisposición en contra de las enseñanzas en el Apocalipsis. La visión de las 7 Trompetas han tenido variadas interpretaciones pero este estudio cuidadoso nos lleva a la realidad considerando la interpretación más razonable de las representaciones de esta escena de juicios de parte de Dios. Vemos que nos lleva al Santuario por los muebles allí mencionados para poder entender. Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: El sábado como un don amoroso de Dios
programme.desc: En esta transmisión especial de dos horas, el pastor John Dinzey, gerente general de 3ABN, y el pastor Eduardo Mack profundizan en el estudio bíblico del sábado, destacándolo no solo como un día de reposo, sino como un regalo divino destinado a restaurar la vida espiritual, emocional y relacional del creyente. A lo largo del programa, ambos pastores presentan el fundamento bí blico del sábado desde la creación hasta el ministerio de Jesús, subrayando su carácter santificado por Dios y su propósito como un espacio sagrado para reconectar con Él. También exploran su relevancia para la vida actual, mostrando cómo la observancia del sá bado fortalece la fe, la identidad espiritual y la relación con el Creador. El objetivo central del programa es invitar al espectador a comprender el sábado como un don amoroso de Dios, diseñado para renovar el corazón y enriquecer la experiencia cristiana hoy. Para una variedad de programas de estudios bíblicos, baje la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscríbase al canal 3ABN Latino YouTube. Envie sus preguntas a Latino@3abn.tv Programa EVH250007.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Descubre los principios bíblicos que revelan si el mensaje, el carácter, las predicciones y la influencia de un profeta están de acuerdo con la Palabra de Dios. Aprende por qué el discernimiento es esencial y cómo los creyentes pueden reconocer el verdadero ministerio profético y evitar el engaño con mayor confianza.\.

programme.title: Jack and Jill

When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Chances Are

But when Alex starts dating Miranda Jeffries (Mary Stuart Masterson) -- his all-grown-up daughter from his previous life -- he remembers his love for Corinne. This spells trouble for his past-life best friend, Philip Train (Ryan O'Neal), who is now pursuing Corinne.

programme.title: Against All Odds

When Terry locates Jessie, the two fall in love. Terry reports that he failed to find her; but Jake sends someone else. Terry and Jessie's love must endure unexpected twists.

And though squatting in a swamp handcuffed to another person is no recipe for romance, Eddie and Michel soon find themselves falling in love even as Losado is closing in.

programme.title: Gloria

Kevin refuses to pay Gloria, so she steals Nicky and the evidence. On the run in the city, the cynical ex-convict and the young boy grow close.

programme.title: Desperate Measures

Conner discovers that incarcerated serial murderer Peter McCabe (Michael Keaton) is a match for Matt, and the psychopath eventually agrees to donate marrow, but he escapes from the operating room just before the procedure. Conner quickly follows, but the scheming McCabe won't be easily apprehended.

programme.title: Mortal Thoughts

If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him.

programme.title: Obsessed

programme.title: It Could Happen to You

Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.","large":"In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: Stealing Harvard
programme.desc: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.","large":"John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime.

programme.desc: Chef Thierry Blouet offers a tour of Puerto Vallarta's street food; La Docena restaurant; the ins and outs of one of Nuevo Vallarta's biggest resort destinations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Wedding rice; ginger and pistachio guacamole.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Spicy honey, garlic and orange roasted duck; skillet corn tamal with duck fat and roasted garlic.

programme.title: Living Well
programme.sub-title: Hummus Sandwiches - Dr. Vanessa & Savonna Greer
programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: The Incredible Journey Season 7
programme.sub-title: Franz Hasel - The Soldier Who Defied Hitler
programme.desc: In 1939, Franz Hasel, a 40-year-old pacifist, received a draft summons, leading him to serve as a Private in the Pioneer Company 699 of the German army. Despite donning the uniform, he opposed the Nazi regime and risked his life to warn villagers of impending danger from SS death squads. In a daring move, he even informed his sergeant that Hitler wouldn’t win the war during the advance into Russia. These actions amounted to treason, punishable by death, yet Hasel survived. His story unfolds as a testament to his defiance against societal norms and his belief in a higher law amidst the chaos of war.

Special attention is dedicated to the end-time conflict and the glorious deliverance of God's faithful remnant. You will be amazed at the predictive preciosion of Bible prophecy and your faith in the Master of history will grow exponentially.

programme.sub-title: How Can I Be Born of the Spirit?
programme.desc: What does it really mean to be "born again"? Is there a line between convinced and converted Adventits? In this seven-part series Dojcin Zivadinovic discusses what true conversion looks like according to the Bible and how we can all experience this re-birth.

programme.title: Timeless Healing Insights from the Gospel of Mark
programme.sub-title: A Light to the Gentiles: Part 1 | Episode 31
programme.desc: The first half of The Gospel of Mark reveals increasingly dramatic evidence that Jesus is the Divine Son of God and the Lover of all humanity. Learn practical implications of these truths in today’s message.

programme.title: Authentic - with Shawn Boonstra
programme.desc: In Authentic, the flagship television and radio program of the Voice of Prophecy, Pastor Shawn Boonstra pursues the deepest questions of human existence.

programme.title: Apostasy: Theological Analysis of the Davidian Movement
programme.desc: Untangling the web of error can be exhaustingly complex. In this series, you will learn to discern the counterfeit. The Davidian Movement, often called the "Shepherd's Rod", has hooked many unsuspecting Bible students who are seeking "Present Truth". By the end of this series, you will recognize and be able to refute the major Davidian doctrines such as Ezekiel 9, the stone of Daniel 2, and the pre-millennial kingdom, as well as their commonly used Bible and Spirit of Prophecy references. You will have a clear understanding of truth by rediscovering the beauty of Adventism; guarding yourself against deception or helping someone already involved with a dissident group. Ephesians 6:11-19 tells us to put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand firm no matter what evil the devil sends your way. False prophets shall arise (Matt 24:11) and false theories, clothed with garments of light, will be presented to God's people… seducing influences exerted; minds hypnotized (Maranatha, Feb 20, "Beware of Satan's Agents", p.59:1). There are grievous wolves in our mists, men speaking perverse things, drawing away disciples after them (Acts 20:29-30). BEWARE! Take heed that no man deceive you (Matt 24:4). "God will arouse His people, if other means fail, heresies will come in among them...We should present sound arguments that will not only silence our opponents, but will bear the closest and most searching scrutiny.. ." (5T, 707:3 - 709). Search the Scriptures and the Spirit of Prophecy by the grace of the Holy Spirit. The speaker has done just this. Praise God! Through His miracle, Ismael was brought out of the Shepherd's Rod deception. Finally, through this series, it is time to set the record straight.

programme.title: Summit 2025: Put on the Whole Armor of God
The Struggle Is Real- Lo-Ammi Richardson
programme.desc: A compelling series about God’s transofrmative power to break the cycle of sin in our lives. With heartfelt insight, Lo-Ammi explains why we struggle and reveals the key to finding the lasting peace we all long for. Through seven transformative steps, you’ll learn how to live as a victorious Christian. The struggle is real but so is the victory through Jesus Christ!

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

What lessons can today’s remnant church draw from their example? programme.sub-title: Se Acerca La Hora De Un Juicio
programme.desc: En 1844 culmina la profecía más extensa de la Biblia. En el drama có smico supra-humano, las tinieblas lucharon por oscurecer los acontecimientos celestiales que se iniciaron 2300 años antes en el 457 a. C. En rápida secuencia una serie de sucesos golpearon las noticias. Aparece el Espiritismo, nace el Evolucionismo, se incia el marxismo-comunismo, se descubre el Código Sinaítico, se genera un edicto de tolerancia a favor de los judíos, surge la Alta Crítica de la Biblia, nacen los discipulos de Cristo, y las Asociación cristiana de jóvenes (YMCA), las comunicaciones ya se producen por telégrafo (cumpliendo el anuncio de Daniel profeta), y el movimiento cristiano se abre paso anunciando la pronta venida de Cristo.

programme.title: Ancla 22: El calendario religioso hebreo
programme.sub-title: Un recorrido a la casa del Mesías
programme.desc: Antes de que Jesús viniera a esta tierra, se sentó con Su Padre y planeó los siete pasos sucesivos que daría en el plan de salvación. Sin embargo, no sólo planificaron los pasos, sino que también prepararon un calendario detallado de cuándo se llevarían a cabo estos pasos. El santuario hebreo revela los eventos de la historia de la salvación y las fiestas revelan el calendario de esos eventos. Este estudio se centra en las siete fiestas y su relación con el santuario. Se incluye un estudio de la temporada del nacimiento del Mesías, los tres días y tres noches, y si los cristianos todavía está n obligados a observar las fiestas. Este estudio fortalecerá su fe en el Dios que conoce el fin desde el principio.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Hired to find a missing person in New Orleans, a merchant seaman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) becomes the prey of those (Lance Henriksen, Arnold Vosloo) who hunt men for sport.","large":"Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Sold into the underworld of gambling and kickboxing, a street criminal (Jean-Claude Van Damme) vies with the world's best fighters in an ancient Tibetan competition.","large":"In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.","large":"As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop.".

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.","large":"Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.","large":"It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.","large":"After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.","large":"After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.","large":"Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. programme.desc: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.","large":"New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a prosperous Louisiana family in 1962 after a girl (Jurnee Smollett) catches her father (Samuel L. Jackson) with another woman.","large":"Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Never 2 Big
programme.desc: A computer whiz (Shemar Moore) suspected of murder seeks an aspiring actress's (Nia Long) help to elude killers and the law.","large":"Freddy (Shemar Moore) is a big-shot music industry executive, whose cousin, Blusette (Salli Richardson), is a successful and well-known singer managed by 8-Ball Harris (Ernie Hudson). Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Friends of each partner conspire to break up new lovers (Tisha Campbell, Rusty Cundieff), then to reconcile them.","large":"Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: Three women (Diane Keaton, Queen Latifah, Katie Holmes) conspire to steal a pile of cash that the Federal Reserve Bank has earmarked for destruction.","large":"After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Determined not to let a demon ruin his sex life, a man hires a priest, ghostbusters and others to banish an evil spirit from his possessed girlfriend.","large":"Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) once again finds himself the target of supernatural shenanigans after he, his new girlfriend (Jaime Pressly), and his girlfriend's children move into their dream home.","large":"After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.","large":"After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: An Asian werewolf (Warner Oland) bites a botanist (Henry Hull) in Tibet and rivals him for the antidote in London.","large":"While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: Bitten by a werewolf, an aristocrat (Lon Chaney) grows fangs, fur and a muzzle, then begs his father (Claude Rains) for help.","large":"When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A serial killer stalking virgins in a small Virginia town targets an idealistic teenager (Brittany Murphy).","large":"A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.","large":"Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.","large":"New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.","large":"Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.","large":"Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.","large":"After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: The Keeping Hours
programme.desc: A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

programme.title: Killer High
programme.desc: Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.","large":"After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: The New Daughter

programme.title: Not Safe for Work

programme.title: Phantasm II
programme.desc: Two psychically linked teens (James LeGros, Paula Irvine) cannot escape from the grave-robbing Tall Man of their nightmares.","large":"Years after surviving his encounter with the sinister Tall Man (Angus Scrimm), Mike Pearson (James LeGros), now a mental patient, still has nightmares about the evil gaunt mortician. Upon being released from the institution, Mike and his friend Reggie (Reggie Bannister) set out to track down the Tall Man and end his murderous and macabre practices. Also involved is Liz Reynolds (Paula Irvine), a pretty young woman who has a psychic connection to both Mike and the Tall Man.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane
programme.desc: Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Strange events haunt a pregnant woman (Virginie Ledoyen) and others at a recently vacated orphanage in the French Alps.","large":"Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.","large":"A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: A man visits a supernatural nightclub during his bachelor party and inadvertently crosses paths with a dancer who is actually a terrifying, legendary creature.","large":"One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: A freshman (Joshua Jackson) joins an elite society that will guarantee him success, but he questions his decision when his reporter roommate dies mysteriously.","large":"For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: A new inductee (Robin Dunne) into the secret society witnesses a murder at the hands of one of its members.","large":"The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: A young woman (Clare Kramer) gets more than she bargained for when she gains entrance to a males-only secret society.","large":"In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. programme.desc: This gritty drama follows unlikely tech entrepreneurs behind a brilliant idea, and a powerful FBI agent ("Sherlock" star Martin Freeman) who can make or break those he comes in contact with -- not always for the right reasons. Set in Miami, Izzy Morales creates a revolutionary, unregulated digital currency called GenCoin. A young banker named Andy decides to partner with Izzy, infusing the project with cash that Andy's father is desperate to conceal. The trio ends up on the radar of FBI Financial Crimes Agent Phil Rask, who is on Andy's trail.

programme.title: Powering the Future
programme.desc: Dr. M. Sanjayan, lead scientist at The Nature Conservancy, shines a spotlight on America's quest for clean energy. The four-part series addresses the challenge from every angle and cuts through all the rhetoric by establishing a target: identifying a clean, limitless, secure energy supply and a way for it to be delivered. Sanjayan discusses new technologies that could end the dependence on fossil fuels; explains how the natural world can create energy; filters out politics and special interests to reveal statistics on energy waste; and tells of unlikely characters and companies that are leading the way in an energy sea change.

programme.title: March of the Wooden Soldiers
programme.desc: Stannie Dum (Stan Laurel) and Ollie Dee (Oliver Hardy) rent rooms in Mother Peep's shoe in Toyland. When Mother Peep can't make her mortgage payment to evil Silas Barnaby (Harry Kleinbach), he attempts to blackmail her into having Little Bo-Peep (Charlotte Henry) marry him, despite the girl's attachment to Tom-Tom Piper. Stannie and Ollie offer their assistance to Mother Peep, Bo-Peep and Piper, and later enlist an army of wooden soldiers to battle Barnaby's cave-dwelling bogeymen.

programme.title: Beyond Tomorrow
programme.desc: George Vale Melton (Harry Carey), Allan Chadwick (C. Aubrey Smith) and Michael O'Brien (Charles Winninger) are rich but lonely, so they invite a pair of strangers, schoolteacher Jean Lawrence (Jean Parker) and cowboy James Houston (Richard Carlson) to their house for dinner on Christmas Eve. Both James and Jean seem to hit it off, but the next day the three old men are killed in a plane crash. Now ghosts, the three work from the afterworld to make sure the young couple stays together.

programme.title: Oklahoma!
programme.desc: There's a box social coming up, and Curly (Gordon MacRae) asks Laurey (Shirley Jones) if she'll be his date. Trouble is, Laurey thinks he's waited too long, and in a fit of pique accepts an offer from the boorish Jud (Rod Steiger) instead. Meanwhile, Laurey's friend Ado Annie (Gloria Grahame) is also torn between two men: a cowboy named Will (Gene Nelson) and a foreign peddler, Ali Hakim (Eddie Albert). Both women struggle to know their own hearts before it's too late.

programme.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
programme.desc: Scout Finch (Mary Badham), 6, and her older brother, Jem (Phillip Alford), live in sleepy Maycomb, Ala., spending much of their time with their friend Dill (John Megna) and spying on their reclusive and mysterious neighbor, Boo Radley (Robert Duvall). When Atticus (Gregory Peck), their widowed father and a respected lawyer, defends a black man named Tom Robinson (Brock Peters) against fabricated rape charges, the trial and tangent events expose the children to evils of racism and stereotyping.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Weit draußen, im Wilden Westen Kanadas, liegt Bella Coola. Es führt nur eine einzige Straße dorthin, der Bella-Coola-Highway. Schotterpisten, enge Serpentinen und steile Berghänge machen die Fernstraße zu einer Herausforderung.

programme.title: Naked

programme.title: Nackte Fakten
programme.desc: Mannequins und Muskelprotze sind zwei Seiten einer Medaille. Beide wollen möglichst gut aussehen. Models schlüpfen dafür oftmals grell geschminkt in ausgefallene Moderoben. Bodybuilder dagegen zeigen ausgeprägte Muskelpartien unter gebräunter Haut.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.desc: Zwei international erfolgreiche Wrestler werden begleitet. Die beiden geben Einblicke in ihren Alltag und erzählen, was der Sport für sie bedeutet. Außerdem teilen sie, welche Gefahren hinter dem populären Extremsport stecken.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura begibt sich diesmal nach Zypern. Von Nikosia aus reist er quer durch das Land zu einem verlassenen Vergnügungspark. Außerdem besucht er ein ehemaliges Asbestbergwerk und ein Schiffswrack, das sich vor der Küste befindet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal ist Cody Buffinton gemeinsam mit Lexi Limitless in New Orleans unterwegs. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden zunächst ein verlassenes Spital in der Stadt in Louisiana. Anschließend trifft Cody noch auf Brutus, einen Riesenalligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh ist in der ehemaligen Sowjetrepublik Armenien unterwegs und besucht die Hauptstadt Jerewan. Er hat vor, dort einige der längst verlassenen, aber noch immer faszinierenden Gebäude aus der Zeit der Sowjetbesatzung zu besuchen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura kehrt nach Gary im Nordwesten des Bundesstaates Indiana zurück, um sich zu Hause einmal genauer umzusehen. Er und seine Freunde erkunden gemeinsam ein ehemaliges Bankgebäude, das Auditorium und den Bahnhof Union Train Station.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody besucht Zagreb, die im Nordwesten gelegene Hauptstadt des Landes Kroatien. Dort feuert er eine Kanone aus dem alten Turm ab und erkundet ein nie fertig gestelltes Universitätskrankenhaus. Außerdem besucht er eine politische Schule.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Die Städteentdecker Josh und Cody besuchen Barentsburg, eine russische Polarstation und Bergarbeitersiedlung am Isfjord auf Spitzbergen. Sie bereisen einige der schönsten Städte der Welt und entdecken dabei viele spektakuläre Orte.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh begibt sich auf eine weitere Reise. Diesmal macht er sich von Tirana, der Hauptstadt des alten Sowjet-Satelliten Albanien, auf den Weg, um Bunker und ein verstecktes Krankenhaus zu besichtigen. Er taucht in einer Piratenhöhle.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody Buffinton erlebt ein weiteres spannendes Abenteuer, als er in Lüderitz, Namibia, unterwegs ist. Er begibt sich in Gebiete abseits der ausgetretenen Pfade, durchquert die Wüste und reist weiter in die Geisterstadt Pomona.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh und Lexi Limitless erkunden gemeinsam die überfüllten Straßen von Tokio, der bevölkerungsreichsten Metropole Japans. Die beiden besuchen ein völlig verrücktes Monster-Café und ein verlassenes Liebeshotel in der faszinierenden Stadt.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal führt die Reise nach Nikko in Japan. Die Stadt liegt etwa 140 Kilometer nördlich von Tokio. Dort trifft Cody auf Sherman Mak. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden einen verlassenen Onsen und einen Vergnügungspark, das Western Village.

programme.title: Kamera-Frauen in der Wildnis
programme.desc: Seit einigen Jahrzehnten erzählen auch immer mehr Filmemacherinnen Geschichten aus der Wildnis. Die Sendung zeigt, was das Besondere an der Verbindung von Frauen zur Natur ist und welche Visionen sie für die Zukunft haben.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Tiere passen sich extremen Bedingungen an: Frösche nutzen Frostschutzmittel in der Leber, Eisbären verlangsamen den Stoffwechsel, Pompeji-Würmer schützen sich mit einem Chitinpanzer und Japanmakaken wärmen sich in heißen Quellen.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Die Kämpfer des Tierreichs wissen sich zu verteidigen. Alligatorenschildkröten nutzen ihren Panzer mit hornartigen Schuppen und scharfen Stacheln als Schutzschild. Die Stacheln des Stachelschweins verfügen über kleine Widerhaken.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die weiten Grasebenen im Herzen Brasiliens, die zu den am wenigsten bekannten Regionen des Landes zählen, werden porträtiert. Diese Graswelt voller Termitenbauten ist zehnmal so groß wie die Serengeti Afrikas, doch Tierherden sucht man vergeblich. Mähnenwölfe, Ameisenbären, Prärieeulen und Kapuzineraffen führen hier ein eher verstecktes Leben, geprägt von Hitze, Gewitterstürmen und Steppenfeuern.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation führt in die Wasserwelt des Pantanal. Jaguare, Fischotter und Wasserschweine sind im Labyrinth aus Flüssen, Seen und Inseln im Vorteil, bis die jährlichen Regenfälle einsetzen. Dann wandelt sich das Pantanal in eine ausgedehnte Sumpflandschaft, in der Kaimane, Fische und Anacondas in ihrem Element sind. Auch Vögel, wie der Jabiru und der Hyazinth-Ara, haben im Pantanal eine sichere Heimat gefunden.

programme.title: Leuchtfeuer des Lebens
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation widmet sich Lebewesen, die ihr eigenes Licht produzieren können. Das ist nicht nur nützlich, sondern auch lebenswichtig für die Wesen, die in der Dunkelheit überleben müssen. Anzutreffen sind sie beispielsweise nachts, in dunklen Höhlen oder der Tiefsee. Dazu gehören Würmer, Pilze und Bakterien. Mithilfe ihres Leuchtens können sie sowohl Beute anlocken als auch Feinde abschrecken oder einen Partner zur Fortpflanzung finden.

programme.title: Die Sicht der Spinne
programme.desc: Derek Muller enthüllt die Geheimnisse des faszinierenden Sehvermögens von Spinnen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Auf der Erde gibt es zwischen fünf und zehn Millionen verschiedene Arten und bis zu zehn Quintillionen Insekten. Das macht die Erde zweifelsfrei zu einem Insektenplaneten. Viele dieser winzigen Tierchen haben außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit der Paarung und Fortpflanzung von den Insekten der Erde. Sie sind kleine Lebewesen in einer großen Welt und haben Tricks entwickelt, um sich gegenseitig für die Paarungsrituale zu finden und Nachwuchs zu zeugen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Soziale Insekten wie Ameisen, Bienen, Wespen und Termiten breiten sich sehr erfolgreich aus. Laut Schätzungen wiegen die Ameisen der Welt so viel wie alle Menschen zusammen. Und das Gewicht der Termiten entspricht dem aller Landwirbeltiere.

programme.title: Bright Now!
programme.desc: Ein alarmierender Rückgang der Insektenpopulationen könnte alles Leben auf der Erde vernichten. In dieser Episode wird untersucht, was dieses Phänomen verursachen könnte und ob es etwas gibt, was getan werden kann, um es zu stoppen.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Heuschnupfen wird zur Volkskrankheit. Fast zehn Prozent aller Krankschreibungen sind auf die allergische Krankheit zurückzuführen. Dazu hat sich die Pollenflugdauer durch den Klimawandel verlängert. Die Sendung zeigt, was Abhilfe schaffen kann.

programme.title: Viren - Der unsichtbare Feind
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt die Erforschung von Viren im Labor und im Krankenhaus dar.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Diagnose unbekannt - Leben mit einer seltenen Erkrankung
programme.desc: Rund 8.000 seltene Krankheiten existieren weltweit. Doch sie werden nur wenig erforscht. Die möglichen Profite für Pharmaunternehmen sind zu gering. Für die Patienten bedeutet das: mit ihrer Krankheit leben lernen.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Eine gesunde Ernährungsweise ist wichtig für die Gesundheit. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie man sich gesünder ernähren kann, indem man frische Zutaten in Mahlzeiten einbaut. Dabei kommt auch der Geschmack nicht zu kurz.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: ADHS bei Erwachsenen - Hummeln im Hirn
programme.desc: ADHS galt lange als Krankheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen. Doch sie kann auch Erwachsene betreffen, wenn sie nicht früh erkannt wird und unbehandelt bleibt. Knapp fünf Prozent der Erwachsenen haben ADHS - und wissen es oft nicht.

programme.title: Wenn die Welt innehält - Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur wollen herausfinden, was Küstenstädte zum Sinken bringt. Außerdem sollen Gelder aufgebracht werden, um die Region zukünftig für die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels zu rüsten.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur forschen nach den Folgen des Klimawandels für Küsteninfrastrukturen inklusive Häfen und den Handel. Außerdem wollen sie wissen, wie gut die betroffenen Gebiete vorbereitet sind.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory of Singapore tauchen ab und erforschen die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels auf den Ozean und sammeln Ideen für künstliche Riffe. Sie entdecken eine Korallenart, die resistent gegen den Klimawandel ist.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Länder und Inseln in Südostasien erheben sich zu großen Teilen kaum über den Meeresspiegel. Von einem Anstieg des Meeresspiegels im Zuge der Klimaerwärmung sind sie daher existenziell bedroht. Es kommt bereits zunehmend zu Überflutungen.

programme.title: TGV: Der große Check-up
programme.desc: Das Technikzentrum Hellemmes in der Nähe von Lille ist das größte Wartungszentrum der SNCF für den Personenverkehr in Frankreich. Der Standort ist auf Wartung und Modernisierung spezialisiert. Die Sendung wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen.

programme.title: Held des Ackers - Ein Hightech-Traktor entsteht
programme.desc: Der Axion 960 CEMOS gilt in Fachkreisen als ein Traktor mit besonders nachhaltiger Technologie. Die Maschine benötigt bis zu 20 Prozent weniger Kraftstoff bei einer Leistung von maximal 445 PS. Die Modelle werden in Frankreich gebaut.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Suche nach einer neuen, vor allem nachhaltigen Energiequelle ist die bislang größte technische Herausforderung. Forscher arbeiten seit Jahren an der Entwicklung eines Fusionsreaktors, der endlos Energie liefern soll, bislang vergebens.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
