programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzendes Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter - einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem "Wings & Wheels"-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes sind spektakuläre Flugstunts am Himmel.

programme.title: Wilde Wege

The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

The only catch: He is forbidden from defending himself against racial bigotry. Supported by his wife (Ruby Dee), Robinson is steadfast in his determination to win.

programme.title: John Ford Goes to War
programme.desc: Director John Ford produces war films for the armed forces; Kris Kristofferson narrates.

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Any Last Words?
programme.desc: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

programme.title: Lulu on the Bridge
programme.desc: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Borderland
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy fools even his partner by acting like a badman to catch a gang of badmen.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A tribe of hostile Native Americans goes on the warpath, slaughtering white men with guns sold to them by mercenary outlaws.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: The Man in the Net
programme.desc: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.desc: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger).

programme.title: The First Time
programme.desc: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her.

programme.title: Hawaii
programme.desc: During the 1820s, a domineering young minister, Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), and his compassionate wife, Jerusha (Julie Andrews), embark on a dangerous sea voyage to Hawaii. When they arrive, Jerusha befriends the Hawaiian people and embraces their customs and culture, while Abner, intent on converting them to Christianity, views them as pagan savages. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
programme.desc: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Feast of Love
programme.desc: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss.

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Amazing Grace
programme.desc: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: A Mexican aristocrat (Michael Pate) dies leading troops against his half brother's rebels (Jock Mahoney) in old California.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: A group of thieves rob a safe of $100,000 and plan to use the money to purchase some land near a proposed railway line. The crooks think they've gotten away with their crime, but they haven't figured on Sabata, a violent bounty hunter with no scruples and a strong desire for cash. He teams up with both his partner, Banjo, and a local bandit named Carrincha. Sabata's fast draw and quick wits make life hell for the thieves.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: War Drums
programme.desc: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether or not to return when war with the Apaches erupts.

programme.title: Fury at Showdown
programme.desc: Reformed ex-convict Brock Mitchell (John Derek) completes a prison sentence for shooting a man in a desperate act of self-defense and travels to the ranch run by his brother, Tracy (Nick Adams). Now an outcast in his own hometown, Brock throws himself into raising animals and working the land. As the newly reconciled Mitchells make up for lost time, vicious gunslinger Miley Sutton (John Smith) finds himself on the payroll of the crooked brother of the man Brock killed.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Whiskey and Ghosts
programme.desc: Davy Crockett's ghost appears and wanders around what looks like the West.

programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Adiós, Sabata
programme.desc: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces.

Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: NFL Fantasy Live
programme.desc: Millions of NFL fans live in a fantasy world where survival depends on successfully navigating the twists and turns of a grueling season. After all, relying on a second-string quarterback or an untested wide receiver to come up big is usually foolhardy. Avoiding such predicaments takes plenty of preparation, and that's where "NFL Fantasy Live" comes into play. Host Marcas Grant provides the advice and analysis fantasy fans need to make winning lineup decisions. And being armed with the latest player updates, stats and trends goes a long way toward turning fantasies into championships.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: The Johnstons -- all seven -- of Forsyth, Ga., are the subjects of this reality-documentary series. The brood, TLC says, are "the world's largest known family of achondroplasia dwarfs." Achondroplasia is a genetic disorder of bone growth, but the series demonstrates that size only matters in the amount of love the Johnstons provide. Trent, a grounds supervisor at a local college, and housewife Amber have two biological children -- Jonah and Elizabeth -- while Anna, Alex and Emma were adopted from Russia, Korea and China, respectively. Episodes deal with everything from high-drama soccer tryouts to a disastrous attempt at a "birds and bees" discussion, all framed by the family tackling a massive renovation of their 6,000-square-foot, circa 1891 home.

programme.title: Mama's Family
programme.desc: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show.".

programme.title: Book TV
programme.desc: This long-running staple of the C-SPAN2 weekend schedule helps expand the channel's programming beyond politics. Most episodes of "Book TV" feature discussions with authors of nonfiction books, usually in the form of interviews, lectures or seminars. The series sometimes includes coverage of major book fairs and festivals. Some of the notable names who have appeared on the show include David Mamet and Tom Clancy.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.desc: Un espacio para los fanáticos de la música regional mexicana, el género musical latino más popular en los Estados Unidos. Entrevistas, acceso exclusivo detrás de bambalinas, conciertos y las últimas noticias de los artistas regionales más importantes del momento. programme.sub-title: El espíritu de la tortilla: Biodiversidad y maíz multicolor
programme.desc: Los mexicanos son los hijos del maíz, así lo dicen los mitos prehispánicos. Este alimento característico ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en la piedra fundacional de la cocina y la vida en México. Pepe Gordon conversa con Cristina Barros Valero, maestra en Letras por la UNAM y una de las mayores divulgadores de la cultura culinaria mexicana, para conversar sobre la relevancia nutricional, histórica, cultural, genética y, por supuesto, gastronómica, del maíz en México.

programme.sub-title: El espíritu de la tortilla: Biodiversidad y maíz multicolor
programme.desc: Los mexicanos son los hijos del maíz, así lo dicen los mitos prehispánicos. Este alimento característico ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en la piedra fundacional de la cocina y la vida en México. Pepe Gordon conversa con Cristina Barros Valero, maestra en Letras por la UNAM y una de las mayores divulgadores de la cultura culinaria mexicana, para conversar sobre la relevancia nutricional, histórica, cultural, genética y, por supuesto, gastronómica, del maíz en México.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Bombas para la paz

Tras realizar varias pruebas, el joven viaja a París donde se va a celebrar una conferencia a la que asistirán los dirigentes más importantes del mundo. programme.title: Tu planeta
programme.desc: Un viaje inolvidable, una visita a los lugares más espectaculares del mundo.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: क्या कहना
programme.sub-title: A young university student's world is rocked when her brief involvement with a wealthy playboy results in her pregnancy
programme.desc: एक लड़की गर्भवती होती है, लेकिन बच्चे का पिता उसे अपनाने से मना करता है। उसका परिवार उसका साथ नहीं देता है जिसपर उसकी एकमात्र आशा उसका अच्छा दोस्त है जो सभी बाधाओं के खिलाफ लड़ने में उसकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: बंजारन
programme.sub-title: The universe offers a Banjara tribe leader's daughter an opportunity to turn her doomed love story into a happily-ever-after with her soulmate
programme.desc: रेश्मा और कुमार रहस्यमय तरीके से अपने पिछले जीवन सेत्रस्त हैं। अंत में जब वे मिलते हैं, उन्हें एक-दूसरे से प्यार होता हैं, लेकिन उनके पिता उन्हें अलग करने का प्रयास करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Rishi Kapoor (Kumar Singh Sesodia / Suraj),Sridevi (Reshma / Devi),Kulbhushan Kharbanda (Rana Uday Ban Singh Sesodia),Gulshan Grover (Shakti Singh),Anjana Mumtaz (Mrs. Singh Sesodia),Pran (Thakur Baba),Raza Murad (Thakur Ranjit Singh),Sudhir Pandey (Sardar Malik),Viju Khote (Bhujangji Maharaj),Rakesh Bedi (Sarju),Sharat Saxena (Girja),Mahavir Shah (Thakur Mahavir Singh)

programme.title: ख़ुदा गवाह
programme.sub-title: Badshah Khan travels to India to behead the man who killed Benazir's father and win her hand in marriage. He succeeds in his mission but is caught by Ranveer Singh, a jailer
programme.desc: बादशाह खान बेनज़ीर के पिता के हत्यारे को खोजने के लिए भारत यात्रा करता है जिससे वह उसे प्रभावित कर सके। वह सफल होता है लेकिन जल्द ही एक हत्या के आरोप में खुद को भारतीय जेल में पाता है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan (Baadshah Khan),Sridevi (Benazir / Mehndi),Nagarjuna (Inspector Raja Mirza),Shilpa Shirodkar (Inspector Heena),Danny Denzongpa (Khuda Baksh),Kiran Kumar (Pasha),Bharat Kapoor (Aziz Mirza),Anjana Mumtaz (Salma Mirza),Vikram Gokhale (Ranveer Sikhri),Beena Banerjee (Ranveer Sikhri's Wife)

programme.title: फरिश्ते
programme.sub-title: Veeru and Dheeru live under the tyrant ruler, Raja Jaichand. Later, they embark on a mission and strive to overcome challenges to defeat the dictator
programme.desc: वीरू और धीरू अत्याचारी शासक, राजा जयचंद के अधीन रहते हैं। बाद में, वे एक मिशन पर निकलते हैं और तानाशाह को हराने के लिए चुनौतियों का सामना करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra (Virendra Kumar),Vinod Khanna (Dhirendra Kumar),Sridevi (Rasbhari),Rajnikanth (Arjun Tange),Jaya Prada (Sheela),Swapna (Gayatri),Sadashiv Amrapurkar (Raja Jaichand),Amrit Pal (Gulshanchandra),Sridevi Kapoor (Rasbhari)

programme.title: सच्चाई की ताकत
programme.sub-title: Sagar sets out to exact revenge against Dr Narendra, a smuggler who killed his father. But Sagar is soon framed for the murder of a woman and sent to jail
programme.desc: सागर अपने पिता को मारने वाले तस्कर, डॉ नरेंद्र से बदला लेने का फैसला करता है। हालांकि, उसे फंसाया जाता और जेल में डाला जाता है तब हवलदार राम सिंह उसकी बेगुनाही साबित करने में मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra,Govinda,Shakti Kapoor,Anupam Kher,Amrita Singh,Ashok Kumar,Sonam,Om Shivpuri,Seema Deo,Dinesh Hingoo,Tej Sapru

programme.title: धरम वीर
programme.sub-title: Twin brothers separated at birth become best friends, unaware of their bond as siblings. The queen, their mother, becomes the uniting force as they set out to defeat their evil uncle
programme.desc: सतपाल यह भविष्यवाणी जानने के बाद कि उसका सबसे बड़ा भतीजा उसे मार डालेगा, वह अपनी बहन के जुड़वाँ बेटों को अलग करता है। हालाँकि, अलग-अलग बड़े होने के बावजूद भी धरम और वीर सबसे अच्छे दोस्त बनते हैं।.

programme.title: निशांत - द नाइट्स एण्ड
programme.sub-title: After his wife Rukmini is abducted by his cruel brother, Vishwam is forced to confront the deep-rooted issues of power and control that plague their village, leading to tragic consequences
programme.desc: अपनी पत्नी रुक्मिणी का क्रूर भाई द्वारा अपहरण कर लिए जाने के बाद, विश्वम को सत्ता और नियंत्रण के गहरे मुद्दों का सामना करना पड़ता है जो उनके गाँव को त्रस्त करते हैं और जिसके दुखद परिणाम सामने आते हैं।.

programme.title: Kotwal Saab
programme.desc: Two siblings drift apart after one of them disapproves of the other's blooming romance with an unknown woman. Eventually, fate reunites them under unexpected circumstances.

programme.title: चिराग
programme.sub-title: When Asha is unable to conceive and loses her eyesight, her mother-in-law throws her out of the house and arranges for her son to remarry
programme.desc: आशा की सास उसे बेघर कर देती है, जब वह गर्भ धारण करने में असमर्थ हो जाती है और आंखों की रोशनी खो देती है। उसकी सास अपने बेटे की दूसरी शादी की तैयारी करती है।.

credits.actor: Sunil Dutt,Asha Parekh,Om Prakash,Kanhaiya Lal,Mukri,Sulochana Latkar,Dulari,Lalita Pawar

programme.title: ड्रीम गर्ल
programme.sub-title: A young woman, conning people to run an orphanage, falls in love with a rich man under the disguise of a princess. However, their romance crumbles when her truth comes out
programme.desc: सपना, बच्चों के अनाथालय के पैसे जमा करने के लिए अमीर लोगों को ठगाती है। जब वह अनुपम से मिलती है, तो खुद को एक राजकुमारी बताती है और उन्हें प्यार हो जाता है लेकिन जल्द ही, सच्चाई सामने आ जाती है।.

programme.title: प्यार ही प्यार
programme.sub-title: At an orphanage, Kailashnath identifies Vijay as his biological son and takes him home. Years later, a man named Ashok arrives and claims to be Kailashnath's real son
programme.desc: कैलाशनाथ एक अनाथालय में अपने बेटे विजय को पहचानता है और उसे घर ले आता है। वर्षों बाद, अशोक नाम का एक व्यक्ति, कैलाशनाथ का असली बेटा होने का दावा करता है।.

programme.title: क्रोधी

Besides their journalistic occupations, one other similar aspect between Tom and Liz is that they are both currently single, with their friends and family doing whatever they can to find that special someone for their personal life. On November 2, the staff at the Voice learn that the Sun ownership has bought their newspaper, with the probable goal of folding it into the operations of the Sun. programme.title: Eps 15 : The Big Interview 2026/27
programme.desc: EPS 15.

programme.title: 裸血 / Raw Passions
programme.desc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠，均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟藉此勒索二人；後孟被殺，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟諾，亦向高勒索；而淩在家，也接見了穀峰，他聲言有為高洗罪的證據，但要索錢；王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶？.

programme.title: 玉女嬉春 / The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展，兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀，江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角，老父回來見三位女兒成就，開心不已。.

programme.title: 勾魂降頭 / Black Magic 2
programme.desc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症，無法以醫學理論解釋，遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查，才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術，以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人，博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說，其妻子更不惜以身相試，更被施以「死降」，如果無法破解，二十四小時後便會身亡….

programme.title: 教頭 / The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害，成殺人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒，卻惹孟不滿；原來周、孟兩大族為死敵，孟覺聘王當教頭，實乃養虎為患，遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲，幸王逃過大難，只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為，且對王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 鐵扇公主 / Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒西行取經，受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山，唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事，牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後，師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，護師脫險。.

programme.title: 血手印 / The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親，但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛，肇德上京考取功名，臨行前會晤未婚妻，怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上，他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審，為他洗脫冤情。.

programme.title: 保鏢 / Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力，於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中，他們遇到了一名神秘俠客，三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪，竭力保護黃金不被劫走。.

programme.title: 少林傳人 / Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位，率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮；皇帝見大勢已去，命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下，大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養，法號道行，習得少林絕技；二太子則易名五子泰，由丞相撫養。多年後，五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」，與道行相遇，卻不知對方正是親兄弟…….

programme.title: 十二金錢鏢 / Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: 喬茂押鏢時，遇女贼袁玉蓉，舉刀要殺之際，卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引，後兩人互生愛慕，更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平，與背後操控袁的老頭，有段血海深仇….

programme.title: 雲泥 / When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。.

programme.title: 單程路 / One Way Only
programme.desc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主，曾是著名車手，惟一次意外中傷殘；他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識，麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車，予以規勸，惟麥受盛名之累，欲罷不能….

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天 / Dawn will Come
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美，心懷不軌，竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後，良才音訊全無，秋容更發現自已懷有身孕，於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻，更打算將秋容滅口….

programme.title: 七煞 / To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」，在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅，並派臥底從內瓦解組織，隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫，幕後壇主可會找出臥底？.

programme.title: 遊俠情 / Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒，杜挺身相救，沐萬分感激。未幾，杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男。及後，杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首領是李之殺父仇人，而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒….

programme.title: 遊俠情 / Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒，杜挺身相救，沐萬分感激。未幾，杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男。及後，杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首領是李之殺父仇人，而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒….

programme.title: 佛都有火 / The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: 故事講述，某寺青年僧人「瘋子」，性格瘋瘋癲癲，行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣，並因應其性格與氣質，授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後，動輒出拳傷人，方丈只得將其逐出寺門...

programme.title: 我為你狂 / Pale Passion
programme.desc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久，但發有神經錯亂，霞為除心理負擔，忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心，令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業，令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間，發狂性大發，霞流產，再次離開發...

programme.title: 邪 / Hex
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋，家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病，而振宇又鬱鬱不得志，故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現，聯同秀英反抗，竟錯手將振宇殺死！秀英自始活在驚恐之中，最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死！原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英，就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際，秀英鬼魂出現...

programme.title: 五毒 / The Five Venoms
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽，各擅勝場，不同型格。電影風格奇特，一開始五毒門清理門戶，派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門，卻受師父追殺，有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运，張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇，沒有他慣常的大義浩然，卻有天地不容的毀滅性。.

programme.title: 仇連環 / Man Of Iron
programme.desc: 仇連環在上海灘以拳頭打出天下，乃好勇鬥狠的典型人物。仇為了交際花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命，與著名幫會首腦之子及同伴展開連場明爭暗鬥，亦成為幫會爭奪地盤的嫁禍目標。.

programme.title: 噴火美人魚 / Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假，忽然聽到新聞報導：一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人，並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時，一個美的女郎破浪而來，身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚，女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突... 電影未到最後一分鐘，不知結局。.

programme.title: 廣東靚仔玉 / Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: 清廷高手駱一虎殺害反清義士陳貴，陳妻偕女小薇逃往廣龍鎮。鎮上兩家武館勢成水火，何教頭之侄家玉生性調皮，因營救小薇識破了老師為反清首領的身份。隨著至親與恩師相繼喪命於駱一虎之手，原本好勝頑皮的家玉憤而承擔起復仇重任，與清廷勢力展開生死決戰。.

programme.title: 女秀才 / The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武，後更考得秀才功名，堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對，均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小，不該再扮男裝，勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同，一時無法抉擇，遂決定由天定奪，怎知陰差陽錯，選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已，才知自己意屬子中….

programme.title: 十字鎖喉手 / Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技，誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是，他潛入凌家作護衛，期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長，兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。.

programme.title: 船 / My Dream Boat
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下，組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。.

programme.title: 鍾馗娘子 / The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: 鍾馗娘子被邪惡的黑金剛擊敗後，隱居多年，處心積慮要復仇。女俠翠屏勇猛堅毅，為剷除黑金剛，懇求鍾馗娘子收她為徒。娘子與翠屏兩師徒聯手對付黑金剛，也是他大限將至的時侯。.

programme.title: 文素臣 / The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察，他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺，聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。.

programme.title: 少林三十六房 / The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: 武打明星劉家輝飾演反清組織成員，並逃難到少林寺求藝。為了報仇雪恨，他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林學懂上乘的武學。他學成少林寺三十五房功夫後，創立少林寺第三十六房功夫。.

programme.title: 白蛇傳 / Madam White Snake
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙，後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...

programme.title: 白蛇傳 / Madam White Snake
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙，後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...

programme.title: 鷹王 / King Eagle
programme.desc: 某天，名震江湖的鷹王遇見重傷的天一堂六舵主，他臨終前告訴鷹王天一堂堂主已被大舵主洪擎天所害，鷹王雖不願多管閑事，但還是遭到洪摯天及其手下顏冰兒的追殺。其後，鷹王出手拯救被監車壓住的女孩，遭到暗算，幸得天一堂七舵主顏玉蓮相救，兩人結為朋友。鷹王告知顏玉蓮六舵主的遺言，並指出其胞妹冰兒不是善類….

programme.title: 天使出更 / Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題，原來該院院長體弱多病，院務交陳醫生主理；但陳個性主觀，行事不依規章，連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」，時鬧笑話，弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革...

programme.title: 鬼新娘 / The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏，兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂，但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下，方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻，然而人鬼殊途，兩人於晨光中淒然訣別，冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳續集 / The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝，並娶得黃蓉為妻，於是把黃蓉挾走，要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範？.

programme.title: 梅山收七怪 / Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃，但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間，導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪，否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 雙喜臨門 / Double Bliss
programme.desc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚，無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭，所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌，答應二人成婚。此時，唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版，最終可謂雙喜臨門。.

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍 / The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲，幾近全軍覆沒，僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺，向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」，後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終，楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手，為楊家將報仇。.

programme.title: 醜聞 / Scandal
programme.desc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內，流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據，得以順水推舟假扮縣長，把各官員玩弄於股掌之中，峰迴路轉，結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默，也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。.

programme.title: 龍虎鬥 / The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: 日本空手道高手及被逐出師門的刁二返鄉踢館，一眾師徒不敵二人，慘遭屠殺。弟子雷明刻苦鍛鍊武功，決心憑一己之力報仇雪恨。一場龍虎對決就此展開….

programme.title: 楊乃武與小白菜 / The Adulteress
programme.desc: 劇情講述，知縣之子劉子和，垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜，用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發，用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後，鎮內流言四起，知縣為救愛兒，設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招，其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死，到刑部要求翻案…….

programme.title: 賣命小子 / The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲，拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識，反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲，四人悲憤交集，遂聯手為友復仇。.

programme.title: 魚美人 / The Mermaid
programme.desc: 貧寒書生張珍投奔相府，卻遭嫌貧愛富的準岳父冷落。碧波潭鯉魚精同情他的遭遇，化身相國千金，深夜與張珍相會，兩人漸生情愫。此事引發「真假千金」鬧相府的風波，更招來張天師降妖圍剿。面對天兵天將，張珍誓死不離，最終感動觀音，令鯉魚精化為凡人，與張珍終成眷屬。.

programme.title: 插翅虎 / The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭，插翅虎及活閻王，的武功，他們必定獨霸武林，江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟，決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞？誰可挽救一場武林浩劫？.

programme.title: 插翅虎 / The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭，插翅虎及活閻王，的武功，他們必定獨霸武林，江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟，決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞？誰可挽救一場武林浩劫？.

programme.title: 樑上君子 / Fast Fingers
programme.desc: 本片為徐蝦導演。 董驃, 錢小豪及蔣金飾扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出獄後裝南洋闊客, 隨錢及蔣返家, 因為想扮相古怪, 惹途人圍觀, 三人乘機施妙手, 更向盤問的保安隊長羅莽自詡身份特殊, 使羅躬身謝罪...

programme.title: 大殺四方 / The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: 故事描述，民初北方軍閥混戰，民不聊生，紛紛向南逃難，三位青年王緒、金正平和魚漢生，夾在難民群中，來到戰區邊沿。王因出手營救一女難民，致遭地方民團首領陳祖光的手下追捕，幸得風塵女子紅菱所救…….

programme.title: 目無王法 / What Price Honesty
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪及羅正三個初出茅廬的捕快，秉除暴安良，維護法紀之宗旨，盡力撲滅罪行，縣中賭館妓院，均遭掃蕩。三人因堅拒與貪贓枉法的縣官與捕頭同流合污，而慘被陷害...

programme.title: 武林風雲 / A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: 故事描述，武義親王恃勢弄權，為奪紫光劍，不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧，並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡，借弔祭為名，實以武力奪劍。甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際，表親徐進到訪，聯手殺退惡奴，但大戰中，徐進、勝男等受傷，無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵…….

programme.title: 劍女幽魂 / Mission Impossible
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師，途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇，藉寶劍靈氣還魂，竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師，更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上，升天而去。.

programme.title: 不了情 / Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中，夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南，兩人漸生情愫，卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時，青青卻得知一個噩耗，最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。.

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 城市之光 / Family Light Affair
programme.desc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景；陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親，卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。.

programme.title: 十二金牌 / The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌，密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵。華山俠士苗龍為救國運，率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌。不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂，令苗龍陷入忠義兩難。最終師徒在客棧反目血戰，苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌，卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾。.

programme.title: 怒海情仇 / Call of the Sea
programme.desc: 故事描述，青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好；土豪獨子耀祖，垂涎小玉美色，時藉故親近；一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂，金虎抱不平，幾動武，惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係….

programme.title: 大羅劍俠 / The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: 女俠明珠的師父遭黑虎幫歹徒偷襲重傷，臨終囑往找故友之女青青，探問失蹤財寶。歹徒偷聽得遺言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大羅劍俠」周應龍，怒打不平…….

programme.title: 春火 / My Son
programme.desc: 楊國良是探長兒子，國良怪父沉迷工作，母離世仍在查案，隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳，兩人母親皆歿，了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢，被陳彪騙下巨款，更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪，遭警察圍捕......

programme.title: 報仇 / Vengeance
programme.desc: 玉樓發現武館師傅封與妻子有著曖昧情愫後，最後更被傅封所殺。玉樓的弟弟小樓得悉兄長被殺後，誓要為兄報仇。.

programme.title: Mencintaimu Sama Dengan Horor
programme.desc: Diputusin pacarnya karena salah paham Brian mencoba move on. Tanpa disenagaja ia bertemu di rumah sakit, Diam-diam Brian terpikat dengan pesona supir ambilance cantik bernama Dea. Namun perjuangan Brian mendapatkan cinta Dea tidaklah mudah.

programme.title: Bila Esok Oma Tiada
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang seorang gadis cantik sederhana bernama Anna (Larasati Nugroho). Pada suatu hari, Anna yang bekerja sebagai perawat lansia bernama Farida atau disebut Oma (Lilis Suganda) kaget saat bekerja. Ketika Anna akan masuk kamar Oma, ia melihat ada sosok misterius mengenakan pakaian serba hitam dan membekapnya. Ia pun berteriak meminta pertolongan. Anna yakin orang tersebut mempunyai maksud tidak baik kepada Oma hingga Anna diserang sosok jahat itu. Beberapa waktu kemudian, setelah Anna tidak dibekap, ia berteriak meminta tolong hingga tiga cucu laki-laki Farida datang. Mereka pun memeriksa kondisi Farida. Salah seorang cucu Farida yang diperankan oleh Elryan Carlen kaget saat melihat omanya telah meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Resepsi Disponsori Pawang Hujan
programme.desc: Rara rela berpura-pura jadi pawang hujan buat bayar hutang dan membiayai pengobatan Babehnya, tapi malah ketemu Angga, pemilik WO yang nggak percaya hal-hal mistis. Kedekatan mereka membuatnya saling jatuh cinta, tapi situasi kian rumit ketika Angga tahu kebohongan Rara dan melaporkannya ke polisi. Namun, berakhir bahagia.

programme.title: My Beautiful (Ex) Sister
programme.desc: Juna (Rizky Alatas) beserta kakak dan babehnya (Tenno Ali), mengalami kecelakaan yang menyebabkan kakaknya Juna meninggal. Padahal saat itu adalah hari bahagia kakaknya yang ingin melamar Karin (Kharisma Adzana). Mendengar kabar bahwa kekasihnya meninggal, Karin sangat sedih. Karin seperti tidak mempunyai semangat untuk hidup. Babeh yang sudah menganggap Karin sebagai anak, meminta Juna menggantikan posisi kakaknya untuk menikah dengan Karin.

programme.title: Satu Kontrakan Tujuan Cintanya Kebanyakan
programme.desc: Citra (Ersya Aurelia) pindah ke kontrakan baru. Tak disangka, tetangganya adalah musuh bebuyutannya sekaligus seleb TokTok terkenal, Farrel (Munggaran Meldrat). Pertengkaran kecil sering terjadi di antara mereka, mulai dari hal sepele sampai yang bikin emosi. Tapi justru dari situ, benih-benih cinta mulai tumbuh. Apakah mereka akan terus bertengkar, atau justru saling jatuh hati?

programme.title: Playboy Cap Kuda Terbang
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Miko (Rendy Kjaernett) takut dengan kuda karena pernah jatuh. Nina (Chrissie Vanessa) bekerja di kandang kuda dan sempat membuat takut Miko saat sedang berkeliling menunggangi kuda. Bukan hanya takut pada kuda, Miko juga terkenal playboy. Ia berpacaran dengan Clara (Fristiana Aldila) dan Sherly (Jovanna) yang keduanya bersahabat. Mereka tidak tau kalau pacar mereka adalah orang yang sama. Miko ingin mencari seseorang yang tulus mencintainya bukan karena ia adalah anak seorang pengusaha.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu

programme.title: Broken Heart Terhebat
programme.desc: Khanza adalah seorang pemilik butik sukses yang harus menjadi sandwich generation dengan beban keluarga yang berat, sementara Arkhan adalah sahabatnya. Keduanya saling memendam perasaan namun terjebak dalam friendzone karena takut kehilangan satu sama lain.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Bolehkah Aku Dijodohkan Sekaliii Saja?
programme.desc: Perjalanan cinta seorang gadis bernama Dara yang sering bernasib sial dalam kehidupan asmara dan sulit menemukan pasangan. Di sisi lain, ada seorang pria yang diam-diam mengaguminya, yakni Gilang. Gilang, yang dulu sering dianggap cupu, kini telah bertransformasi menjadi seorang pengusaha kedai kopi yang sukses. Cerita berfokus pada bagaimana perjodohan ini akhirnya menjadi awal dari benih-benih cinta sejati mereka.

programme.title: Mencintaimu Sama Dengan Horor
programme.desc: Diputusin pacarnya karena salah paham Brian mencoba move on. Tanpa disenagaja ia bertemu di rumah sakit, Diam-diam Brian terpikat dengan pesona supir ambilance cantik bernama Dea. Namun perjuangan Brian mendapatkan cinta Dea tidaklah mudah.

programme.title: Resepsi Disponsori Pawang Hujan
programme.desc: Rara rela berpura-pura jadi pawang hujan buat bayar hutang dan membiayai pengobatan Babehnya, tapi malah ketemu Angga, pemilik WO yang nggak percaya hal-hal mistis. Kedekatan mereka membuatnya saling jatuh cinta, tapi situasi kian rumit ketika Angga tahu kebohongan Rara dan melaporkannya ke polisi. Namun, berakhir bahagia.

programme.title: My Beautiful (Ex) Sister
programme.desc: Juna (Rizky Alatas) beserta kakak dan babehnya (Tenno Ali), mengalami kecelakaan yang menyebabkan kakaknya Juna meninggal. Padahal saat itu adalah hari bahagia kakaknya yang ingin melamar Karin (Kharisma Adzana). Mendengar kabar bahwa kekasihnya meninggal, Karin sangat sedih. Karin seperti tidak mempunyai semangat untuk hidup. Babeh yang sudah menganggap Karin sebagai anak, meminta Juna menggantikan posisi kakaknya untuk menikah dengan Karin.

Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Po-Stagram
programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 19
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Tayo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo Teman-teman~ Belajarlah untuk tumbuh menjadi anak yang sehat bersama Tayo. Mari belajar tentang pengendalian emosi, kebiasaan baik, dan keterampilan sosial bersama Tayo!

programme.title: Doby & Disy
programme.desc: Doby & Disy menyelamatkan teman-teman mereka yang terjebak dalam mimpi. Mereka bertemu Peri Mimpi & Detektif Kubi, dan bersama-sama melawan penyihir jahat yang ingin awet muda.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Tim sepak bola terhebat di dunia harus menghadapi tantangan baru, di mana bakat saja tak cukup dan setiap pertandingan penuh kejutan dari lawan.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Po-Stagram Season 2
programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 19
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pororo
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo Season 2
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Tayo Creator Clip
programme.desc: Saat Tayo dan teman-temannya menjalani hari, lihatlah teman-teman baru yang mereka temui.

programme.title: Poyo Poyo Story Vending Machine
programme.desc: Mesin penjual cerita memompa semua jenis cerita menyenangkan dari Pororo. Tayo dan Titipo!

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Morphle - English Season 7
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Jangan Bercerai Bunda (Rr)
programme.desc: Nabila adalah seorang ibu dan wirausahawan yang memiliki tiga orang anak. Dalam kehidupan rumah tangganya bersama sang suami, Arga, berbagai lika-liku pun muncul. Terungkapnya perselingkuhan Arga dengan wanita lain membuat Nabila dihadapkan pada situasi yang penuh dengan pilihan.

programme.title: Afc Champions League Elite 2026/2027
programme.desc: AFC Champions League Elite 2026/2027 edisi ke-45 turnamen antarklub tertinggi Asia yang diikuti oleh 40 tim, menyajikan format liga baru yang sengit siap melahirkan juara benua sejati, jadi pastikan Anda tidak melewatkan setiap drama, aksi memukau, dan gol spektakuler sepanjang musim ini!

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Anak Jalanan (Rr)
programme.desc: Boy, seorang anak motor jagoan jalanan, dikagumi oleh banyak gadis. Namun, di dalam hati Boy hanya ada Adriana, mantan kekasihnya yang telah meninggalkannya. Boy kemudian bertemu dengan Reva, yang merasa takjub melihat kemampuannya dalam mengendalikan sepeda motor.

programme.title: Seputar Inews
programme.desc: UEFA Nations League adalah kompetisi sepak bola dua tahunan yang diselenggarakan oleh Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Sebening Embun (Rr)
programme.desc: Perjuangan tulus seorang gadis cilik bernama Intan dalam merawat ibunya, Nayla, yang mengalami gangguan jiwa akibat trauma masa lalu. Meskipun Nayla kerap bersikap dingin dan tidak mengakuinya sebagai anak, Intan tetap setia mendampingi dan menyayanginya dengan penuh kesabaran. Di tengah keterbatasan tersebut, kehidupan mereka semakin diuji oleh kemunculan rahasia asal-usul keluarga, pengkhianatan orang-orang terdekat, serta berbagai konflik yang memisahkan mereka, namun kasih sayang Intan terus menjadi harapan utama bagi kesembuhan sang ibu.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Tanpa Karena (Rr)
programme.desc: Perjalanan cinta Nuna dan Dipta harus menghadapi jalan yang terjal. Mulai dari terhalangnya restu orang tua, jarak yang memisahkan, hingga rasa cemas karena Dipta merupakan seorang abdi negara yang setiap harinya harus mempertaruhkan nyawa. Berbagai rintangan pun menguji kesetiaan cinta mereka.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Tertulis Untuk Kita (Tayang Perdana)
programme.desc: Kencana menyelidiki pembunuhan ayahnya yang ternyata melibatkan Hardiman, pengusaha sukses yang ternyata juga memiliki hubungan dengannya. Dalam prosesnya, Kencana bekerja sama dengan Glen, yang juga menyimpan dendam terhadap Hardiman atas kematian kakaknya dan pencurian desainnya. Keduanya berusaha membongkar kejahatan Hardiman, di tengah konflik keluarga, persaingan bisnis, dan kisah cinta yang tumbuh di antara mereka.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Jangan Bercerai Bunda (Rr)
